name: 808 kick
why: A soft thud with a long, low boom after it. Where the 909 punches, the 808 blooms.

ingredients.name: A plain kick
ingredients.adds: Four kicks to the bar from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The 808
ingredients.adds: A rounder attack and a tail that rings like a low note.
ingredients.listenFor: The click goes and a boom arrives.

ingredients.name: Round it off
ingredients.adds: Takes away what is left of the click.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.below: All boom: it turns into a bass note.

ingredients.name: Level
ingredients.adds: How far the kick sits above the rest.

knobs.above: It clips and flattens the mix.
